label: Ipswich Town
title: Ipswich hold Forest to a draw

sentences.text: Ipswich Town drew 1–1 with Nottingham Forest, after Neco Williams scored first and Julio Enciso equalised in the 41st minute.
No goals followed after the break.
Ipswich are 9th with 10 points from 8 matches.
Next, Hull City host Ipswich Town on Saturday 31 October, kicking off at 15:00 local time.

outro: That is all from VOZ for now, thanks for listening.
